During a cooperative period, we welcome your thoughts; we looked into it and understand that your complaint concerns the care, handling, and condition of your companion animal during travel, along with the service response you received at the airport and on board. We regret that this experience did not meet the standards expected from Aurelia Skyways, and we appreciate the opportunity to address it carefully.

Our review shows that passengers are given clear guidance before departure, and that the safety coordinator is responsible for identifying hazards and explaining prevention measures before the journey begins. We also confirmed that the ground team is instructed to move carriers with care between services and to follow the animal-specific handling plan prepared for the trip. When a concern is raised, the Companion Animal Travel Desk expects staff to document the matter promptly, preserve any relevant reports, and route the case for review without delay.

<<FACT F117>>

If your complaint involved cabin overheating or a related welfare concern, please continue to keep all supporting records, including your booking details, veterinary notes if applicable, and any written report from airport or cabin staff. These materials allow the case reviewer to assess the conditions accurately and to determine whether further action is warranted under Aurelia Skyways procedures. If your pet required attention after the journey, please ensure that the facts are recorded in the same sequence in which they occurred, as this supports a proper review.

<<FACT F113>>

If you believe the handling of your companion animal fell short of our standards, we ask that you submit the remaining supporting documents through the usual service channel so the review may proceed. We will consider whether the care plan matched the animal's needs, whether the transfer process was followed, and whether the communication you received was clear and timely. Where improvements are identified, we use them to strengthen future guidance, staff coordination, and cabin and ground handling practices.

Thank you for bringing this matter to Aurelia Skyways. We remain committed to careful review, respectful communication, and the safe transport of companion animals.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
